audit_items.proof_trace: `accrue_interest` increases `cash_reserve` by `reserve_factor * debt * rate * Δt` without any post-check that `cash_reserve.ceil() <= cash`; at high utilization (small `cash`, large `debt`) sustained interest accrual will eventually push `cash_reserve > cash`. Once violated, every call to `withdraw_underlying` aborts via `assert!(self.cash >= self.cash_reserve.ceil())` (L313), DoS-ing `burn_ctokens`, `liquidate_ctokens`, and `take_revenue` on the affected market.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An attacker borrows to near-maximum utilization (e.g., 99%), leaving minimal `cash`; any subsequent operation triggering `accrue_interest` compounds reserves faster than the tiny remaining `cash`, eventually locking all depositor withdrawals and liquidations until borrowers voluntarily repay.
